experiment: MED008 Gate2A: evidence-backed candidate fact QA, not clinical approval or trained model
fact_grounding: Every candidate answer is an exact substring of the same patient original note; char offsets validated
clinical_quality: AI-assisted seeded Q&A; semantic/clinical expert review required before publication/training
train_eval_rule: No frozen holdout question/answer was used as seed; new eval split is never trained. Notes may contain eval facts by design.
limitations: Eight pilot patients have been used in earlier MED experiments; no patient-independent unseen test here.
Holding out QA wording is NOT holding out underlying facts, because original notes contain the facts.
MED000E full QA pretraining may have encountered same patient facts; cross-training duplication not excluded.
Question/answer semantic equivalence and differential diagnoses require clinical review.
NLL and patient-code ranking do not establish clinical correctness.
No machine unlearning or GPU training performed at Gate2A.
